Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick tech triage request before demo

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick reply on our trial signup — we spun up a short PoC (project id: fc-2734) and want to validate compatibility with our latency and on-device caching needs before a full demo. Our infra team is particularly concerned about: high sustained QPS (500–1k rps), 2xx latency at p50/p95, and whether Redwood can be integrated with our VPC + KMS setup.

Would one of your engineers be available for a 15-minute technical triage tomorrow or Tuesday to confirm there's nothing blocking a formal pilot? We don't need a product demo yet — just a short architecture sanity check.

Windows that work for us (PDT):
- Mon Apr 26: 09:30–10:00 or 14:00–14:30
- Tue Apr 27: 11:00–11:30

If those don't work, we'll adapt. Happy to share our trial logs and a short network diagram ahead of time. Thanks — Samira

—
